items.q: How do I become a member?
items.a: Sign up with a sponsor code from the person who introduced you and the code of a franchise. Both are on the sign-up form.

items.q: Where can I buy the products?
items.a: At any franchise, or with your shopping wallet from your member portal. Prices on this website include taxes.
No. Commission is paid only on verified retail product sales. Signing someone up does not by itself earn anything, and earnings are not guaranteed.

items.q: How do I withdraw my earnings?
items.a: Add and verify your bank details once, then request a withdrawal from your portal. The head office reviews and pays it.

items.q: How do I open a franchise?
items.a: Choose a plan in the Franchise opportunity section and send us an enquiry. The head office will explain the investment, the stock supplied to you and how the prepaid account works.

items.q: What if I have a problem with an order?
items.a: Raise a support ticket from your portal, with photos if they help. The head office replies in the same ticket.

items.q: What does the investment pay for?
items.a: It goes into your prepaid account and is used to buy stock from the head office for joining and repurchase products.

items.q: Can I upgrade my plan later?
items.a: Yes, talk to the head office. Upgrades are decided by the head office.

items.q: Can a franchise manage other franchises?
items.a: Larger plans can supply and manage smaller franchises. The head office manages every franchise.
No. Results depend on your location, your effort and the demand for the products.

opportunity.title: How you can earn
opportunity.text: A clear plan built on real retail sales. No hidden steps, and every figure shows up in your own portal.

cards.title: Direct referral commission
cards.text: Earn commission when someone you personally introduced buys products.

cards.title: Team (level) commission
cards.text: Earn a smaller share on verified retail purchases made by your team, down through the levels below you.

cards.title: Repurchase royalty
cards.text: Earn a small share, across up to 10 levels, when your team buys products after joining. Buy any products in any quantity: there is no fixed repurchase package and no compulsory monthly purchase.

opportunity.title: Get a little back every day
opportunity.intro: On eligible product purchases you earn cashback each day for a limited time. It goes to your income wallet, and you do not need to buy again to keep what you have earned.
opportunity.note: Paid only on delivered product orders, and taken back in proportion if an order is refunded. Not available on every product.

opportunity.title: The commission levels
opportunity.intro: When a purchase in your team is delivered, a percentage of its retail value is shared up the levels. These are the current rates.
opportunity.note: Rates can change for future orders. Orders already placed keep the rate they were bought under.

items.q: Do I earn by recruiting people?
items.a: No. Commission is paid only on verified retail product sales. Signing someone up does not by itself earn anything.
After the product is delivered and a short cooling-off period has passed. If an order is refunded, the related commission is reversed.

items.q: How do I withdraw my earnings?
items.a: Add and verify your bank details once, then request a withdrawal from your portal. The head office reviews and pays it.

items.q: What do I need to join?
items.a: A sponsor code (from the person who introduced you) and the code of a franchise. Both are on the sign-up form.
No. Earnings vary and depend on your own effort and your team’s retail purchases.
